en.hubeali:
Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Safwan, from Yunus, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Maazy<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:
‘The commiters of the major sins, all of them, the Penalty (Hadd) would be established upon them twice. They would be killed during the third’.
